generationContract.source: one portrait per call on a uniform opaque #00FF00 or #FF00FF matte selected opposite the costume palette
generationContract.framing: close head-to-mid-thigh; complete head, hair, clothing, anatomy, weapons, and props clear of the top and both side edges; lower clothing or a downward prop may crop only through the bottom
generationContract.edge: character pigment meets key matte directly; no white or off-white backlight, paper border, pale underpainting, dry-brush fade, rim light, glow, haze, or keyed spill
generationContract.promptRetention: Each portraits[].finalPrompt is the exact revised prompt returned for the accepted ImageGen output.

normalization.operation: infer and validate uniform key matte, recover alpha, decontaminate keyed fringe, preserve source aspect ratio, normalize to a readable combat-cell silhouette, crisp the alpha band, and fade only the authorized bottom crop
normalization.outputContract: 960x1280 RGBA; no top or side alpha contact; about 6% clear top; authored aspect ratio preserved; alpha width 68-94%; painted height 87-94%; semitransparent visible ratio <=3%; pale low-alpha fringe <=64 pixels; keyed-hue fringe <=64 pixels

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: opaque production source for a Solitaire dark-fantasy mobile combat portrait; background will be chroma-keyed later.
Images 1-5 are mandatory style and medium references only. Learn their traditional watercolor-and-gouache anime illustration, expressive living faces, airy colored midtones, broad readable costume masses, selective detail, and candid observed-moment quality. Do not copy any identity, costume, pose, anatomy, prop, or scenery.
Create one generalized unnamed archetype in premium hand-painted watercolor and gouache anime realism, with visible pigment variation, softened transitions, lightly textured interior brushwork, elegant facial planes, and selective crisp accents. Never glossy 3D, photographic, hyper-rendered, or generic mobile-game art.
Composition: portrait orientation, close head-to-mid-thigh three-quarter stance, large face, natural asymmetry, off-camera attention, practical interrupted gesture. Center and scale the COMPLETE silhouette inside an inset rectangle. A perfectly empty key-color band at least 10% of canvas width must remain on BOTH left and right sides at EVERY vertical position. A key-color band at least 9% of canvas height must remain above the highest hair, garment, hand, weapon, or prop. No hair, cloak, sleeve, garment, body part, weapon, or equipment may touch or exit the top or either side edge. Broad lower garments must stay narrow enough to preserve both full-height matte side columns. ONLY the horizontal bottom edge may crop lower clothing. Do not zoom out to full body.
Background: DO NOT create transparency or checkerboard. Use one perfectly uniform opaque unlit key-color matte filling every non-character pixel and every gap between hair, fingers, straps, and equipment. No texture, gradient, floor, shadow, halo, vignette, scenery, or matte spill.
Edge contract: character pigment meets key matte directly in a clean firm naturally antialiased silhouette. Absolutely no white/off-white backlight, paper border, pale underpainting, watercolor bloom outside silhouette, dry-brush fade, feathering, glow, rim light, mist, haze, pale speckles, or transitional halo around hair, clothes, armor, skin, or props. Highlights stay inside silhouette.
No text, UI, border, watermark, companion, particles, extra limbs, impossible overlap, clipped anatomy, direct camera smile, or squared roster pose.
